{"test_name": "Ledger_2297_Objection3", "test_code": "using System;\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Emit;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection3\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public Task GeneratedFormatter_NetStandard20_OmitsExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n        => AssertFormatterExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(new[] { \"NETSTANDARD\", \"NETSTANDARD2_0\" }, expectAttribute: false);\n\n    [Fact]\n    public Task GeneratedFormatter_NetStandard21_CarriesExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n        => AssertFormatterExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(new[] { \"NETSTANDARD\", \"NETSTANDARD2_1\" }, expectAttribute: true);\n\n    [Fact]\n    public Task GeneratedFormatter_Net60_CarriesExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n        => AssertFormatterExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(new[] { \"NET\", \"NET6_0\", \"NET6_0_OR_GREATER\", \"NET5_0_OR_GREATER\" }, expectAttribute: true);\n\n    [Fact]\n    public Task GeneratedFormatter_Net80_CarriesExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute()\n        => AssertFormatterExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(new[] { \"NET\", \"NET8_0\", \"NET8_0_OR_GREATER\", \"NET6_0_OR_GREATER\", \"NET5_0_OR_GREATER\" }, expectAttribute: true);\n\n    private static async Task AssertFormatterExcludeFromCodeCoverageAsync(string[] preprocessorSymbols, bool expectAttribute)\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\n            using MessagePack;\n\n            namespace TestNamespace\n            {\n                [MessagePackObject]\n                public class SampleObject\n                {\n                    [Key(0)]\n                    public int Id { get; set; }\n\n                    [Key(1)]\n                    public string Name { get; set; }\n                }\n            }\n            \"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> references = net80Refs.Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack));\n\n        CSharpParseOptions parseOptions = new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest, preprocessorSymbols: preprocessorSymbols);\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ConsumerAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, parseOptions) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(\n            new[] { new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator() },\n            parseOptions: parseOptions);\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.Empty(runResult.Diagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        Assert.All(runResult.Results, r => Assert.Null(r.Exception));\n\n        ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> outputErrors = outputCompilation\n            .GetDiagnostics()\n            .Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)\n            .ToImmutableArray();\n        Assert.Empty(outputErrors);\n\n        using MemoryStream ms = new MemoryStream();\n        EmitResult emitResult = outputCompilation.Emit(ms);\n        Assert.True(emitResult.Success, string.Join(Environment.NewLine, emitResult.Diagnostics));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol formatterSymbol = Assert.Single(\n            outputCompilation\n                .GetSymbolsWithName(\"SampleObjectFormatter\", SymbolFilter.Type)\n                .OfType<INamedTypeSymbol>()\n                .Where(s => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(s.ContainingAssembly, outputCompilation.Assembly)));\n\n        bool hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage = formatterSymbol\n            .GetAttributes()\n            .Any(attr => attr.AttributeClass?.ToDisplayString() == \"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\");\n\n        Assert.Equal(expectAttribute, hasExcludeFromCodeCoverage);\n    }\n}\n"}
